title: market_data
description: File shape of data/processed/market_data.json. series holds [date, adj_close] pairs in the instrument's listing currency, strictly ascending by date, with no forward-fill (rows exist only on days a price was reported). adj_close is already adjusted for splits and dividends: use it as is for returns. fx_usdcad holds [date, CAD per 1 USD] pairs (Bank of Canada), strictly ascending, with no row on Canadian holidays: consumers take the latest rate on or before the date they value (backward match) and report its age in days.
